heroSub: KisanQ connects Farmers, Buyers, Mandi Inspectors, and Supervisors on a unified digital yard. Featuring atomic slot reservations, AI quality pre-grading, competitive offer windows, and a SHA-256 tamper-evident audit ledger.
farmerPortalDesc: Register your harvest, analyze crop quality with AI pre-grading, book mandi arrival tokens, and accept the highest competitive buyer offer.
buyerMarketplaceDesc: Browse verified crop listings across mandis, review AI estimates and moisture specs, place secure price offers, and track bid confirmations.
inspectorOpsDesc: Scan and check in arrival tokens at the gate, conduct physical weighbridge quality grading, manage storage headroom, and resolve disputes.
supervisorAuditDesc: Review the global immutable audit log across all mandis, verify SHA-256 hash-chain integrity, and inspect grade override justifications.
accessControlDesc: PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) isolates farmer lots, restricts inspector reads to assigned mandis, and enforces least privilege.
ledgerDesc: Every critical lifecycle transition appends an immutable record with previous-hash linkage, verified on demand by supervisory RPCs.
weighbridgeDesc: AI pre-grades serve strictly as pre-arrival estimates. Official transactions bind only to physical weighbridge inspections.
simulatedNoticeDesc: These illustrative values are not sourced APMC prices and must not be used for trading decisions. A verified source adapter is required before live-price use.
